stories.h: Tacoma council tweaks budget ahead of Nov. 18 adoption
stories.s: Facing a $40 million deficit, the council funded five community service officers through 2028 and $450,000 for behavioral health case management. Final budget adoption is planned for Nov. 18.

stories.h: Eastbound Narrows Bridge lanes close tonight
stories.s: Two right eastbound lanes of SR 16's Tacoma Narrows Bridge, the toll plaza and ramps from 24th and 36th streets close 8 p.m. Friday to 6 a.m. Saturday for joint cleaning.

stories.h: Overcapacity Tacoma shelter asks public to adopt dogs
stories.s: The Humane Society for Tacoma & Pierce County took in 130 dogs since Nov. 1 and waived adoption fees for adult dogs Nov. 12–13. It also seeks foster homes, especially for large breeds.

stories.h: Stronger storm to follow Friday's rain this weekend
stories.s: Rain spreads in late Friday into Saturday, with a stronger, windier system Saturday night into Sunday. River flooding isn't expected, but residents should clear leaf-clogged storm drains.

coming.h: Arts at the Armory in Tacoma
coming.s: Free arts weekend at the Tacoma Armory, 1001 S. Yakima Ave., 11 a.m.–5 p.m. Saturday and Sunday.

coming.h: Peninsula Art League national show opens
coming.s: The 24th National Fine Art Show opens at Gig Harbor Vintage Aero Museum; open Tue–Sat 1–4 p.m. through Dec. 3.

coming.h: Puyallup Fall Kids Day and Makers Market
coming.s: Free family event with activities, music and a youth makers market, 10 a.m.–1 p.m. at Pioneer Park Pavilion.

coming.h: Tacoma council set to adopt 2027-28 budget
coming.s: The City Council plans to adopt its biennial budget, closing a $40 million deficit, at its Nov. 18 meeting.
